comparison.objective: Install impalement-rated caps rather than mushroom caps on upright rebar; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests cap selection, alignment, and downward seating; candidate tests hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar adjustment, force-limited locking, and iterative cycle evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the correct protective caps seated on rebar; candidate requires two bounded dynamic stops with no bottoming, rebound, overload, or drift.
comparison.reason: Protective cap selection/insertion is not damping commissioning. The record has no specs and omits seating-force, retention, and cap-count details.
